# Red before green — the six new agent-run contract cases against HEAD's script

- Tree: HEAD `4263cec1f`, `scripts/agent-run.sh` unchanged (`git diff --quiet -- scripts/agent-run.sh` exit 0);
  `.github/scripts/test_agent_run.py` carrying the six new cases (plan step 1).
- Command: `python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts -p test_agent_run.py -v` — exit 1.
- Summary: `Ran 20 tests in 1.007s` · `FAILED (failures=5)`; the fourteen standing cases `... ok`.

| case | reading at HEAD | first diagnostic |
|---|---|---|
| test_run_session_runs_the_flow_target_of_seven_guis | FAIL | `AssertionError: 2 != 0` — the usage text `run selections: stand · all · <blitz-tests file name>` |
| test_run_session_before_boot_exits_3 | FAIL | `AssertionError: 2 != 3` — `session` names no file, so the usage gate fires before the boot check |
| test_run_session_with_an_extra_argument_exits_2 | ok | the existing argument-count gate (`[[ $# -eq 2 ]] || usage`) already exits 2 — green at HEAD, as the plan allowed |
| test_session_is_a_fixed_word_before_a_file_of_that_name | FAIL | `['test', '-p', 'blitz-tests', '--locked', '--test', 'session'] != ['test', '-p', 'seven_guis', '--locked', '--test', 'cli_flow']` |
| test_a_failing_session_flow_exits_1_and_carries_no_captured_output | FAIL | `AssertionError: 2 != 1` |
| test_an_empty_session_run_is_never_a_pass | FAIL | `AssertionError: 2 != 1` |

Against the plan's prediction («the five session-running cases red, the two exit-2/exit-3 cases possibly green by the
existing usage gate»): five red as predicted; of the two usage-adjacent cases, the exit-2 case reads green by the
existing argument-count gate and the exit-3 case reads RED (exit 2, not 3) — at HEAD `session` is no file, so usage
decides before the not-booted precondition.
